name: Girl
source:
A young girl with blond hair and green eyes who was left by Harumichi as a heritage.
Not only her appearance, but voice and behaviour are adorable and innocent. Even her sulky face and angry voice are charming.
Her age and origin are unknown. She also doesn't know anything about herself, and even can't take a meal by her own.
She earnestly adores her Master (Masashige) and entrusts everything to him.
